description: This header file declares functions and types for hash lookup operations, including searching for object IDs and hashes within sorted tables, using fanout tables for efficient binary search.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Finds the position of a specific object ID within a table.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a hash within a hashed table, using a fanout table to narrow the search interval.
